title: Tauranga Gym Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best gym deals in Tauranga, including current joining offers, free trials, and the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme, to help you save money on your fitness journey.
intro: Tauranga's vibrant gym culture offers a range of options, from budget-friendly to premium services. With several gyms across the city, including City Fitness, Les Mills, and boutique studios like F45 and Contours, there's something for everyone. Here's a rundown of the best gym deals in Tauranga this June 2026.

sections.heading: Current Gym Deals in Tauranga
sections.body: Several gyms in Tauranga are offering attractive deals for new members. City Fitness is currently offering a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week, making it the best value full-service gym. Anytime Fitness provides 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide. Les Mills has introduced a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract, while F45 is offering a free trial week. Additionally, the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme offers 40-70% off for eligible members, which includes new members or those who have been inactive for 12 months or more.
list: Anytime Fitness: 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide
Les Mills: Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Best Value Gyms in Tauranga
sections.body: When it comes to value for money, City Fitness stands out as the best option, with its affordable pricing and comprehensive services. Les Mills is the premium pick, offering high-quality equipment and group fitness classes. Anytime Fitness is the no-contract pick, providing flexibility for members who prefer not to be locked into a long-term contract.
list: City Fitness: Best value full-service gym
Les Mills: Premium pick with high-quality equipment and group fitness classes
Anytime Fitness: No-contract pick with 24/7 access

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Joining a Gym in Tauranga
sections.body: To make the most of your gym membership, consider the following money-saving tips. Firstly, take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme if you're eligible. Secondly, opt for a month-to-month membership instead of a long-term contract. Thirdly, look for gyms that offer free trials or guest passes to try before you buy. Fourthly, consider joining a gym during off-peak hours or during promotions. Lastly, calculate the total cost of your membership, including any additional fees or services.
list: Take advantage of the Exercise NZ subsidy scheme
Look for free trials or guest passes
Join during off-peak hours or promotions
Calculate the total cost of your membership
